args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212,
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build
failure in tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/round-half-even-fin-212
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which broke `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switched the import and rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run ci-0001 on this branch passed (all tests green).

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `src/money.py`'s docstring promised banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This broke `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`).

## Change
- Switched the `decimal` import and the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented FIN-212 behavior.

## Verification
- CI run ci-0001 on the fix commit (08d3cd5986): passed.
- CI run ci-0002 after merging latest main (0a9452f727): passed.
